'''Tom Vandervelden''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Green Bay tournament]] on 25 August 2001 with Senate/Maul's site podracing, according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2896">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-26-episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25d2896/ episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 26 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-26-episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25d2896/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
